doctrine: WORD DECISION CONTAINER (Hadi, 2026-10-24): every word carries a recorded decision — a treatment, or a deliberate as-is — grounded in tempo, effect, and story function. A word with no record is randomness.
carriage: Standalone decisions/word-decisions.json in this package. The shipped scene predates in-scene decision containers and carries no per-word compartment (verified at migration by grep of the shipped scene), and this scene family carries no per-word positional data — the scene's own carriage for a word is its timing — so the layer lives in the package's decisions folder at the exemplar standard (soa-01 / wd-01). The shipped scene itself is NOT edited: it is a locked, published artefact.
source: Authored 2026-10-26 (JOB WORD-AUTHOR-1) from the shipped scene's own evidence: words.json timings (160 word objects: word, start, end, line), the renderer behaviour in hidden_files/wordanim-proto-v3/build_html.py (the shipped scene's build script: the .w word engine, the sentence-group fades, and every named cue), and the script doc's per-scene intents (files/short-intro-a1-v3-script.md, production notes).
authoring_note: COVERAGE HONESTY: these are records OF THE SHIPPED PIECE, derived on 2026-10-26 from its evidence. No record claims a decision taken at build time (2026-10-22) — the piece predates the per-word discipline, and its build-time intent survives only at scene level (the script doc's production notes). Where the renderer treats every word alike — the appear/pulse/settle engine — the record says so in the treatment and grounds the individual word by its tempo and its job in the line; where the renderer singles a word out (the L1 title rows, the 28 cue words), the record names the specific behaviour from the code. This file supersedes the migration's absence record (JOB MIGRATION-12, 2026-10-26); that record's account of why the layer was absent — the piece predates the discipline; the 2026-10-23 context audit counts elements only — stands as the layer's history.
